reply_text:
I told Pree in her direct message that her cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is **21 October**, as she said on 14 October. She hasn't changed it since.

The brain refused to look up my saved note because this connection isn't tied to any one member. So I read the date from her own direct message with me, which she can see herself.

To make saved notes readable again, whoever runs the brain server needs to tie this connection to a member: `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`. Since I serve several people, that probably means setting it up to act on behalf of each member who asks. Until then, saving notes still works but I can't read them back.
